steps.name: Notify parent issue of sub-task completion
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Extract 1-based index from title: [Sub-task N/M]
INDEX=$(echo "$ISSUE_TITLE" | grep -oP '\[Sub-task \K[0-9]+')
ZERO_INDEX=$((INDEX - 1))

# Resolve parent from parent-{N} label
PARENT_NUMBER=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/labels" \
  | jq -r '.[] | select(.name | startswith("parent-")) | .name' \
  | head -1 \
  | sed 's/parent-//')

if [ -z "$PARENT_NUMBER" ] || [ "$PARENT_NUMBER" = "null" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Could not resolve parent issue number for sub-task #$ISSUE_NUMBER"
  echo "Labels on this issue:"
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
    "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/labels" | jq .
  exit 1
fi

echo "Sub-task #$ISSUE_NUMBER (index $ZERO_INDEX) completed. Notifying parent #$PARENT_NUMBER"

HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$PARENT_NUMBER/comments" \
  -d "{\"body\": \"<!-- bot-workflow-terminal --> <!-- bot-subtask-complete: $ZERO_INDEX -->\"}")
if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "201" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Failed to post comment to parent #$PARENT_NUMBER (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Successfully posted completion notification to parent #$PARENT_NUMBER"

steps.name: Clean global git config
steps.run: git config --global --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader || true git config --global --unset-all credential.helper || true

steps.name: Check if git-flow-ai cache is needed

run-task.if:
github.event.action != 'closed' &&
(
  github.event_name == 'workflow_call' ||
  (github.event_name == 'issues' &&
   (inputs.CALLER_AUTH == 'off' ||
    contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'),
             github.event.issue.user.author_association)) &&
   !startsWith(github.event.issue.body, '<!-- bot-agent-') &&
   !startsWith(github.event.issue.body, '<!-- bot-workflow-terminal -->') &&
   (contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@genius') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@ctx') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@dev') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@review') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@issue') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@issue-reviewer') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@debug') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@po') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '@@summarize') ||
    contains(github.event.issue.body, '/workflow'))) ||
  (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
   (inputs.CALLER_AUTH == 'off' ||
    contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'),
             github.event.comment.user.author_association)) &&
   ((!startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- bot-agent-') &&
     !startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- bot-workflow-terminal -->') &&
     (contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@genius') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@ctx') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@dev') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@review') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@issue') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@issue-reviewer') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@debug') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@po') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@@summarize') ||
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '/workflow'))) ||
    contains(github.event.comment.body, '"function_call"') ||
    contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- workflow-continue -->') ||
    contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- bot-summarizer-trigger -->') ||
    contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- bot-subtask-complete') ||
    contains(github.event.comment.body, '<!-- bot-trigger:')))
)

CALLER_AUTH.description: When "on", only OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR authors can trigger the workflow from issues/comments

agent_config_path.description: Path to the layered YAML config file (providers → llms → agents)

history_comment_count.description: Number of most recent issue comments injected into each agent call (pinned comments are always added on top)

pin_comment.description: When true, pin every agent step output comment for verbatim context injection (issue #617)

prompt_body.description: The prompt/body text for the agent to process (required for external callers)

runs_on.description: Runner label for workflow jobs (default: ubuntu-latest; e.g. "self-hosted" to use your own runners)

summarizer_threshold.description: Summarizer threshold — number of comments before summarizer triggers

COMMANDCODE_API_KEY.description: API key for Command Code LLM provider (optional - only needed if you want to use it as provider)

GH_PAT.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for API access

LOCAL_VLLM_API_TOKEN.description: API key for vLLM (optional — only needed if using local vLLM provider)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Default API key for the LLM provider (used as fallback)
